title: NASA-UAP-D031, STS-80 Unidentified Object Image 2, 1996
what_is_it: A photograph (still image) taken by astronauts during a NASA Space Shuttle mission, showing an unidentified object in orbit.
interpretation_warnings: No source text was extractable from the file; all facts derive from war.gov metadata/CSV description, not the image itself.
The 'unidentified object' characterisation and the 'free-floating object' interpretation are descriptive claims from the release metadata, not an independent analysis.

A tumbling free-floating object near the Earth's limb is commonly consistent with mundane explanations such as orbital debris, ice particles, or detached shuttle hardware; the metadata does not rule these out.
